name: Over-relaxation Sphere Tracing
aliases: Over-relaxation Sphere Tracing with Screen-Space Intersection Selection
Over-relaxation sphere tracing with screen-space selection
definition: A sphere tracing variant that uses over-relaxation to accelerate convergence and selects the final intersection point based on screen-space error metrics to reduce aliasing and improve visibility in the distance.
summary: Over-relaxation Sphere Tracing accelerates convergence by stepping beyond signed distance bounds, using screen-space error metrics to select final intersections and reduce aliasing.
